hyperedges.label: CMS initialization flow: createCMS consumes CMSConfig, initializes CMSContext, iterates CMSPlugins
Admin UI stack: createAdminClient (server) → createAdminHooks (bound) → AdminQueryProvider (context)
Three tsup platform groups (neutral, node, browser) enforce runtime boundary separation
S3-compatible storage adapters (AWS, R2, Hetzner) all implement CMSStorageAdapter via presigned PUT URLs
mediaPlugin and pagesPlugin both implement CMSPlugin and register Elysia routes via CMSContext
BlockDefinition, BlockUnion, and InferBlockData form a typed block system used by pagesPlugin
All storage adapters (aws, r2, hetzner, local) implement CMSStorageAdapter presign interface
KeyMarker, VarsMarker, PluralMarker, RichMarker all compose into LeafMarker union
useTranslations, usePageContent, useLocale all depend on CMSContext via useCMSContext
